commit_message:
Add packet router

Routes live in a slice and are scanned linearly: there are at most eight,
and a map lookup was slower in the per-packet benchmark.

Serve clears the read deadline before each read: the TLS proxy in front
of the gateway sets one on accepted conns, and idle links would time out.

context.text: 1500 is the Ethernet MTU; frames on this link never exceed it.
Drop instead of blocking: a slow handler must not stall the read loop.
